values.name: UNA not supported
values.description: Notification that the UNA character string cannot be understood or complied with.

values.name: Syntax version or level not supported
values.description: Notification that the syntax version and/or level is not supported by the recipient.

values.name: Message version/release not supported
values.description: Notification that the message type, version number and/or release number in the UNG and/or UNH segments are not supported by the recipient.

values.name: Service segment missing/invalid
values.description: Notification that a service segment is missing, contains invalid data or cannot be processed for any reason.

values.name: Trailer check in error
values.description: Notification that data contained in the trailer does not agree with data in the header and/or that the functional group or message or segment count is incorrect.

values.name: Data segment missing/invalid
values.description: Notification that a data segment is missing, contains invalid data or cannot be processed for any reason.

values.name: Interchange recipient not actual recipient
values.description: Notification that the Interchange recipient (S003) is different from the actual recipient.

values.name: Too many data elements in segment
values.description: Indication that a data segment contains too many data elements.

values.name: Mandatory data element missing
values.description: Indication that a mandatory data element is missing in a service or data segment.

values.name: Data element attribute error
values.description: Indication that a data element does not conform to the relevant message or segment specification.

values.name: Password invalid
values.description: Indication that the password in segment UNB is invalid.

values.name: Invalid value
values.description: Notification that the value of a simple data element, composite data element or component data element does not conform to the relevant specifications for the value.

values.name: Missing
values.description: Notification that a mandatory (or otherwise required) service or user segment, data element, composite data element or component data element is missing

values.name: Value not supported in this position
values.description: Notification that the recipient does not support use of the specific value of an identified simple data element, composite data element or component data element in the position where it is used. The value may be valid according to the relevant specifications and may be supported if it is used in another position.

values.name: Not supported in this position
values.description: Notification that the recipient does not support use of the segment type, simple data element type, composite data element type or component data element type in the specific in the identified position.

values.name: Too many constituents
values.description: Notification that the identified segment contained to many data elements or that the identified composite data element contained too many component data elements.

values.name: No agreement
values.description: No agreement exist that allows receipt of an interchange, functional group or message with the value of the identified simple data element, composite data element or component data element.

values.name: Unspecified error
values.description: Notification that an error has been identified, but the nature of the error is not reported.

values.name: Invalid decimal notation
values.description: Notification that the character indicated as decimal notation in UNA is invalid, or the decimal notation used in a data element is not consistent with the one indicated in UNA.

values.name: Character invalid as service character
values.description: Notification that a character advised in UNA is invalid as service character.

values.name: Invalid character(s)
values.description: Notification that one or more character(s) used in the interchange is not a valid character as defined by the syntax level indicated in UNB. The invalid character is part of the referenced-level, or followed immediately after the identified part of the interchange.

values.name: Invalid service character(s)
values.description: Notification that the service character(s) used in the interchange is not a valid service character as advised in UNA or not one of the service characters in the syntax level indicated in UNB or defined in an interchange agreement. If the code is used in UCS or UCD, the invalid character followed immediately after the identified part of the interchange.

values.name: Unknown Interchange sender
values.description: Notification that the Interchange sender (S002) is unknown.

values.name: Too old
values.description: Notification that the received interchange or functional group is older than a limit specified in an IA or determined by the recipient.

values.name: Test indicator not supported
values.description: Notification that a test processing could not be performed for the identified interchange, functional group or message.

values.name: Duplicate detected
values.description: Notification that a possible duplication of a previously received interchange, functional group or message has been detected. The earlier transmission may have been rejected.

values.name: Security function not supported
values.description: Notification that a security function related to the referenced-level or data element is not supported.

values.name: References do not match
values.description: Notification that the control reference in UNB/UNG/UNH does not match the one in UNZ/UNE/UNT.

values.name: Control count does not match number of instances received
values.description: Notification that the number of functional groups/ messages/segments does not match the number given in UNZ/UNE/UNT.

values.name: Functional groups and messages mixed
values.description: Notification that individual messages and functional groups have been mixed at the same level in the interchange.

values.name: More than one message type in group
values.description: Notification that different message types are contained in a functional group.

values.name: Lower level empty
values.description: Notification that the interchange did not contain any messages or functional groups, or a functional group did not contain any messages.

values.name: Invalid occurrence outside message or functional group
values.description: Notification that an invalid segment or data element occurred in the interchange, between messages or between functional groups. Rejection is reported at the level above.

values.name: Nesting indicator not allowed
values.description: Notification that explicit nesting has been used in a message where it shall not be used.

values.name: Too many segment repetitions
values.description: Notification that a segment was repeated too many times.

values.name: Too many segment group repetitions
values.description: Notification that a segment group is repeated to many times.

values.name: Invalid type of character(s)
values.description: Notification that one or more numeric characters were used in an alphabetic (component) data element or that one or more alphabetic characters were used in a numeric (component) data element.

values.name: Missing digit in front of decimal sign
values.description: Notification that a decimal sign is not preceded by one or more digits.

values.name: Data element too long
values.description: Notification that the length of the data element received exceeded the maximum length specified in the data element description.

values.name: Data element too short
values.description: Notification that the length of the data element received is shorter than the minimum length specified in the data element description.

values.name: Permanent communication network error
values.description: Notification that a permanent error was reported by the communication network used for transfer of the interchange. Re-transmission of an identical interchange with the same parameters at network level will not succeed.

values.name: Temporary communication network error
values.description: Notification that a temporary error was reported by the communication network used for transfer of the interchange. Re-transmissions of an identical interchange may succeed.

values.name: Unknown interchange recipient
values.description: Notification that the interchange recipient is not known by a network provider.
